column2: A grand ancient Chinese Han dynasty city gate: a massive rammed-earth and grey brick wall section with a large arched wooden double gate in the middle, topped by a two-storey wooden gate tower with red lacquered columns, carved brackets and grey ceramic tiled hip roofs with gracefully upturned eaves.
